newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's SEG Dasheng 1996 net surges.
newsitem.headline: China's SEG Dasheng 1996 net surges.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.41 yuan vs 0.08 yuan
Net assets per share 3.90 yuan vs 3.49 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen SEG. Dasheng Corp Ltd.
Note: The results, under Chinese accounting standards, were published in a statement in Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday.
Television tube maker Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd is the biggest shareholder of Dasheng, an audio equipment maker that has diversified into property development and entertainment, the report said.
Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd held 24.28 million state shares in Dasheng at end-1996, accounting for 32.97 percent of Dasheng's 73.64 million outstanding shares, the report said.

Dasheng's board of directors proposed to make a three-for-10 bonus share issue based on 1996 profit and a 6.5-for-10 bonus issue based on its capital surplus, which needs approval of its shareholders at an annual general meeting on May 5.
